criteria.name: claim_support_rate
criteria.description: What percentage of high-risk claims are fully or partially supported?

criteria.name: overextension_control
criteria.description: Are claims appropriately scoped — not making broader assertions than evidence supports?

criteria.name: opinion_framing
criteria.description: Are opinion-based assertions clearly framed as such rather than stated as fact?

criteria.name: source_quality
criteria.description: Where sources are cited or implied, are they credible and relevant?
